# Gate your CI on architecture

Fail pull requests that add a dead event, a dispatch loop or an unresolved dispatch, and show reviewers what changed.

```bash
php artisan loom:scan
php artisan loom:check
```

<!-- generated:output:check -->
<!-- Generated by `just docs-generate`; edit the source, not this block. -->

```text
orphan-listeners — Every listener handles at least one event
  ✗ Listener App\Listeners\AuditOrders handles no events.
orphan-events — Every event is dispatched or handled
  ✗ Event App\Events\OrderCancelled is never dispatched and never handled.
cyclic-dispatch — No cyclic event/job dispatch chains
  ✗ Cyclic dispatch: App\Events\InventoryAdjusted → App\Events\OrderPlaced → App\Events\InventoryAdjusted
3 violation(s) across 3 rule(s).
```
<!-- /generated:output:check -->

The branch added a listener pair that dispatch each other's events; the app also has an unused event and an untyped listener. `loom:check` exits `1` on a violation and `2` when it couldn't run, so fail the job on any non-zero code. Each rule and its fix is in [Check rules](../reference/check-rules-and-formats.md#rules).

Without a reference point `unresolved-dispatches` checks nothing. Compare against a baseline to [fail on new unresolved dispatches](../recipes/new-unresolved-dispatches.md), or pass `--strict` to fail on all of them.

## See what changed

`loom:diff` lists what moved between two indexes:

```bash
php artisan loom:diff .loom/baseline.json storage/loom/index.json
```

<!-- generated:output:diff -->
<!-- Generated by `just docs-generate`; edit the source, not this block. -->

```text
events
  + {"id":"App\\Events\\InventoryAdjusted","fqcn":"App\\Events\\InventoryAdjusted","kind":"class","file":"app/Events/InventoryAdjusted.php","line":5,"dispatched_from":[{"file":"app/Listeners/ReserveStock.php","line":12,"method":"App\\Listeners\\ReserveStock::handle"}],"handled_by":[{"listener":"App\\Listeners\\RecountStock","method":"handle"}]}
  ~ App\Events\OrderPlaced
      handled_by:
        + {"listener":"App\\Listeners\\ReserveStock","method":"handle"}
      dispatched_from:
        + {"file":"app/Listeners/RecountStock.php","line":12,"method":"App\\Listeners\\RecountStock::handle"}

listeners
  + {"fqcn":"App\\Listeners\\RecountStock","file":"app/Listeners/RecountStock.php","line":8,"handles":[{"event":"App\\Events\\InventoryAdjusted","method":"handle"}],"registration":"discovery_unverified","queued":false,"after_commit":false,"dispatches":[{"target":"App\\Events\\OrderPlaced","kind":"event","confidence":"high","file":"app/Listeners/RecountStock.php","line":12}]}
  + {"fqcn":"App\\Listeners\\ReserveStock","file":"app/Listeners/ReserveStock.php","line":8,"handles":[{"event":"App\\Events\\OrderPlaced","method":"handle"}],"registration":"discovery_unverified","queued":false,"after_commit":false,"dispatches":[{"target":"App\\Events\\InventoryAdjusted","kind":"event","confidence":"high","file":"app/Listeners/ReserveStock.php","line":12}]}

unresolved_dispatches
  + {"file":"app/Services/Notifier.php","line":9,"expression":"event($eventClass)","reason":"dynamic_class_name"}
```
<!-- /generated:output:diff -->

`+` is an added entry and `~` one whose links changed. Like `git diff --exit-code`, it exits `1` when anything changed and `2` on bad input, so a bare `loom:diff` step fails the job; fail only on `2`.

## Run both on every pull request

The Loom Action scans the branch, runs `loom:check`, diffs against the base branch and posts one sticky PR comment:

```yaml
name: Loom
on: pull_request

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  loom:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: lucasp1337/laravel-loom@v0.4.0
        with:
          strict: "true"
```

The job fails with the exit code of `loom:check`. The Action never passes a baseline, so set `strict: "true"` or unresolved dispatches go unchecked. If the base branch can't be scanned, the diff is skipped and the job still passes. Inputs, outputs and the fork limit are in the [Action reference](../reference/action.md).
